caption: The drawing depicts a detailed rendering of a large pitcher with a handle and a hinged lid, shown in the center of the composition in sepia and brown tones with shading to indicate form and texture. The body of the pitcher is decorated with raised relief patterns of flowers and leaves, creating a textured floral motif that covers most of its surface. The handle is sturdy and intricately designed, and the metallic lid is depicted in a dark grey color. There are two smaller, inset drawings: the top left inset shows a side view of the pitcher, highlighting the same floral relief and handle design; the bottom right inset presents a view from the front, emphasizing the relief decoration and the alignment of the handle and lid. The background is a light beige, and a thin rectangular border encloses the central and inset images. The artist's signature appears on the lower right of the central area.
title: Syrup Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
